description: PRD-141 — Platform Reliability, Single-Path Consolidation & Auto Self-Management (phased rewrite). Backend-only. Six phases, dependency-ordered by stability payoff (NOT by effort): Phase 0 Error Telemetry Foundation (US-001/002), Phase 1 Mem0 Async Stability — the actual crash fix (US-003..008), Phase 2 Dynamic Resource Limits — kills silent agent bails (US-009..012), Phase 3 Unified Tool Selection Pipeline — removes duplicate ranking (US-013..016), Phase 4 Tool Routing Negative Signals (US-017..019), Phase 5 HARNESS Self-Management — HIGH RISK, behind HARNESS_SELF_MANAGEMENT_ENABLED flag default false, ships LAST (US-020..026). Source PRD: docs/PRDS/PRD-141-PLATFORM-RELIABILITY.md. Original diagnosis by Devin was verified accurate; this rewrite fixes spec bugs found during verification: WS-3 wrong action names (platform_assign_tool -> platform_assign_tool_to_agent), invented method _apply_single_approved_task (use existing _auto_apply_prescription), missing authz on /approve, non-existent platform_create_routing_rule (routing_rule_add dropped for v1), and WS-4 fire-and-forget DB-session-per-call (replaced with batched recorder). Phases 1 and 5 require a single-workspace canary soak before broad rollout. The 1,941 except Exception handlers are OUT OF SCOPE — only the 24 bare except: are fixed.
